digo_source: Pakia (2005) App. III; Pakia (2005) App. VI

teaser.en: The 'male' *mwangajine* has huge leaves and large cream flowers, and like its namesake it is a medicine for spiritual illness.
teaser.sw: *Mwangajine* 'dume' ana majani makubwa mno na maua makubwa ya rangi ya krimu, na kama yule aliyepewa jina lake, ni dawa ya maradhi ya kiroho.
teaser.dg: *Mwangajine* 'mlume' una makodza makulu sana na maruwa makulu ga rangi ya maziya, na dza *mwangajine* uriohalana nao kpwa dzina, ni dawa ya makongo ga pepho.

summary.en: *Mwangajine mlume* is a large-leaved shrub or small tree of evergreen coastal forest, often on coral rock. It is a spiritual medicine, like the *mwangajine* it is named after, and it is listed as Vulnerable.
summary.sw: *Mwangajine mlume* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wenye majani makubwa wa msitu wa pwani usiopukutika majani, mara nyingi juu ya mawe ya matumbawe. Ni dawa ya kiroho, kama *mwangajine* ambaye amepewa jina lake, na umeorodheshwa kama Hatarini (Vulnerable).
summary.dg: *Mwangajine mlume* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wenye makodza makulu, wa matsaka ga pwani ga mihi yenye makodza chila wakati, na mara nyinji unamera dzulu ya mawe ga sanoo. Ni dawa ya makongo ga pepho, dza *mwangajine* uriohalana nao kpwa dzina, na ukaandikpwa *Vulnerable* (uri hatarini).

about.en: *Mwangajine mlume* is a shrub or small tree with very large leaves, long and broad, which make it stand out in the forest undergrowth. Its flowers are large and cream-coloured, thick-petalled in the way of the custard-apple family.
about.sw: *Mwangajine mlume* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wenye majani makubwa sana, marefu na mapana, yanayoufanya uonekane wazi katikati ya mimea ya chini msituni. Maua yake ni makubwa na ya rangi ya krimu, yenye petali nene kama ilivyo kwa familia ya mitopetope.
about.dg: *Mwangajine mlume* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wenye makodza makulu sana, mare na mapana, ganayouhenda uonekane wazi kahi ya vitsaka vya tsakani. Maruwage ni makulu na ga rangi ya maziya, na vipande vya ruwa ni vinene dza vya mimea ya jamii ya *custard apple*.

where.en: It grows in evergreen coastal forest, often on coral rock.
where.sw: Hukua katika msitu wa pwani usiopukutika majani, mara nyingi juu ya mawe ya matumbawe.
where.dg: Unamera kpwenye matsaka ga pwani ga mihi yenye makodza chila wakati, mara nyinji dzulu ya mawe ga sanoo.

uses.en: It is used as a spiritual medicine, in the same way as *mwangajine*.
uses.sw: Hutumika kama dawa ya kiroho, kwa namna ile ile kama *mwangajine*.
uses.dg: Nkuhumirwa dza dawa ya makongo ga pepho, dza *mwangajine*.

culture.en: The name is explained as 'male spirit-being': this is the large-leaved *mwangajine*, the male partner to *mwangajine* (*Isolona cauliflora*). Both carry the names of the spirits Mwanga and Jine.
culture.sw: Jina lake hufafanuliwa kama 'kiumbe-roho dume': huyu ni *mwangajine* mwenye majani makubwa, mwenzi wa kiume wa *mwangajine* (*Isolona cauliflora*). Wote wawili wamebeba majina ya pepo Mwanga na Jine.
culture.dg: Dzina nkuelezwa kukala 'pepho mlume': uhu ni *mwangajine* wa makodza makulu, mlume wa *mwangajine* (*Isolona cauliflora*). Mihi yosi miiri ina madzina ga pepho Mwanga na Jine.

names.en: Pakia records two Digo names, *mwangajine mlume* and *mzondohera nguluwe*. Duruma shares the name *mwangajine*. No Swahili or English common name has been recorded; botanists call it *Uvariodendron kirkii*. *Mzondohera nguluwe* is also recorded as the Digo name of a different shrub, the sandpaper saucer-berry (*Cordia monoica*).
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi majina mawili ya Kidigo, *mwangajine mlume* na *mzondohera nguluwe*. Kiduruma kinatumia pia jina *mwangajine*. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa; wataalamu wa mimea huuita *Uvariodendron kirkii*. *Mzondohera nguluwe* pia limerekodiwa kama jina la Kidigo la kichaka kingine, *sandpaper saucer-berry* (*Cordia monoica*).
names.dg: Pakia anaandika madzina mairi ga Chidigo, *mwangajine mlume* na *mzondohera nguluwe*. Aduruma piya anahumira dzina *mwangajine*. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa; asayansi anauiha *Uvariodendron kirkii*. *Mzondohera nguluwe* piya ukaandikpwa dza dzina ra Chidigo ra chitsaka chanjina, *sandpaper saucer-berry* (*Cordia monoica*).

conservation.en: *Mwangajine mlume* is listed as Vulnerable on the IUCN Red List and depends on the remaining evergreen coastal forest.
conservation.sw: *Mwangajine mlume* umeorodheshwa kama Hatarini (Vulnerable) katika Orodha Nyekundu ya IUCN, na unategemea misitu ya pwani isiyopukutika majani iliyobaki.
conservation.dg: *Mwangajine mlume* ukaandikpwa *Vulnerable* (uri hatarini) kpwenye IUCN Red List, na unakuluphira matsaka ga pwani ga mihi yenye makodza chila wakati garigosala.

reason.en: The 'female' partner, also a spiritual medicine
reason.sw: Mwenzi 'jike', nao pia ni dawa ya kiroho
reason.dg: *Mwangajine*, 'mchetu' wa mmea uhu, na piya ni dawa ya makongo ga pepho.

reason.en: Named after the same spirit, Mwanga
reason.sw: Umepewa jina la pepo yule yule, Mwanga
reason.dg: *Mwanga*, una dzina ra pepho mwenga, Mwanga.
*Mzondohera nguluwe*, una dzina hiri hiri, *mzondohera nguluwe*.

reason.en: Mkilua, same custard-apple family, also Vulnerable
reason.sw: Mkilua, wa familia ile ile ya mtomoko, nao pia uko Hatarini
reason.dg: *Chilua*, cha jamii mwenga ya *custard apple*, na piya chiri hatarini (*Vulnerable*).
